```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse=TRUE, comment="#>")
library(nlrFlow)
```

```{r}
okra <- nl_data("okra_growth_means")
f <- nl_fit(data=okra,model="gompertz",response="fruit_length",predictor="day_after_flowering",engine="nls")
b <- nl_boot(f,R=50,type="residual",seed=10)
nl_confint(f,"bootstrap",boot=b)
nl_predict(f,interval="confidence",boot=b)
```
